text:
tom_sales: Hey team — last night I covered dinner with an external product lead from Acme who joined us to review integration specs. I paid on my corporate card and split the bill 50/50. The guest's portion was EUR 45. Our expense form only has employee fields  can we expense the guest share back to the company? I attached the receipt and the guest's business card.

anna_finance: Hi Tom  paying for external guests is allowed but usually requires pre-approval. Post-facto we can handle it if you provide: (1) a clear business justification, (2) guest name + company, and (3) manager approval. Also we need to confirm this is a business meal (no personal benefit). Please include that in the expense notes.

tom_sales: Got it. Business justification: reviewed integration API and agreed on P0 changes; Acme product lead will be a beta customer. Guest: Maria Santos, Product Lead, Acme Corp. Receipt attached: hotel-restaurant-0612.pdf (total EUR 90).

max_manager: I approve this expense. Confirming the meeting was business-related and that reimbursing the guest's share is fine. @anna_finance please mark manager_approval=yes.

julie_peopleops: Quick reminder: for audits we need the guest company and sign-off that there was no personal benefit. A short one-line statement in the expense notes is fine: "Meeting with Acme Product Lead re: integration; no personal benefit."

reimburse-bot: Please submit using the following template in the expense notes:
```
expense_type: meals_guest
date: 2026-06-12
amount_claimed: EUR 45
guest_name: Maria Santos
guest_company: Acme Corp
attendees: tom_sales, Maria Santos
manager: max_manager
manager_approval: yes
attachments: hotel-restaurant-0612.pdf, maria_businesscard-0612.jpg
justification: Reviewed integration API and agreed on beta onboarding; no personal benefit
```

anna_finance: Once you submit with that template we'll send it for manual review. Guest meals sometimes require a short hold for compliance (usually <48 hours). If everything checks out we'll reimburse the EUR 45 to your corpcard or personal payment method (whichever you used).

tom_sales: Submitted as expense ID 99288 with the template and attachments. Thanks for the quick help :thumbsup:

anna_finance: Received 99288. Marked for manual compliance review. Will update thread when cleared (typically 1-2 business days).
